info.title: HRIS Hiring API
info.description:
Login with `POST /auth/login`, copy the `token`, click **Authorize** and paste it.

All responses are JSON. Validation errors return 422, missing/expired token 401, no permission 403, rate limit 429.

post.summary: Login and get an API token

example.message: Your account is inactive. Contact HR.
These credentials do not match our records.

email: These credentials do not match our records.

post.summary: Logout from all devices (revoke every token)
Change own password (other devices are logged out)

password.description: Min 10 chars with upper and lower case, number and symbol

post.summary: Send a password reset link by email
post.description: Always returns the same message, whether or not the email exists.

example.message: If an account exists for this email, a password reset link has been sent.

post.summary: Set a new password using the token from the email link
post.description: The reset link opens `FRONTEND_URL/reset-password?token=...&email=...`. Token is valid for 30 minutes. All devices are logged out.

password.description: Min 10 chars with upper and lower case, number and symbol

post.description: multipart/form-data. JPG, PNG or WEBP, max 1 MB, max 2000×2000 px. The old logo file is deleted.

post.description: job_code is generated as {country ISO3}-{practice code}-{00001}, e.g. IND-JAVA-00001, numbered per country + practice. It does not change if the job is later edited. Status defaults to Draft. New skill names are added to the skill master.

put.summary: Update a job (send only changed fields)
put.description: Arrays (skills, recruiter_ids, vendor_ids) replace the current list when sent. Setting a final status (closed / filled / cancelled) sets closed_at.

post.summary: Read a JD file and suggest job form values
post.description: multipart/form-data with `file` (PDF, DOCX, XLSX or TXT, max 5 MB). Nothing is saved. Returns the description as safe HTML and the fields that could be matched.

422.description: Wrong type, too large, or no readable text

post.summary: Attach (or replace) the JD file of a job

get.summary: All dropdown data for job screens in one request
get.description: Active countries, practice areas, clients, vendors (A–Z), job statuses, and active users when the caller may view users. Replaces 7 separate list calls.

put.summary: Update a practice area (send only changed fields)

get.summary: Active statuses of one module (for status dropdowns)

post.description: Permission: `users.create`. No password is sent — the user receives an email link to set it. New users are always Active.

message.example: User created. A link to set the password has been emailed.

get.description: Permission: `users.view`, or any user viewing their own profile.

put.description: Permission: `users.update`. Send only the fields to change. You cannot change your own role or status. Changing role/status logs the user out of all devices.

delete.description: Permission: `users.delete`. Soft delete: user is set inactive and all tokens are revoked. You cannot delete yourself.
